title: Kansas debuts digital platform replacing 60-year-old paper-driven regulation system
summary: A new digital platform is hoped to provide transparency, accessibility and speed to a system that's more than 60 years old.

title: California Gov. Newsom appoints new data chief
summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom has appointed John Ohanian, former chief data officer of the state's human services agency, as the new statewide CDO.

title: First BEAD-funded internet connections go live in Louisiana, Nebraska, with fixed wireless towers
summary: The two BEAD-funded internet connections in Nebraska and Louisiana signal a shift from the program's tenuous planning phase to deployment.

title: Louisiana Senate approves blockchain ‘task force’ resolution
summary: A blockchain and innovation task force in Louisiana would explore the financial upside to better supporting industries that rely on distributed ledger technology.

title: Despite AI call-monitoring concerns, NYC corrections plans to renew $23M telecom contract
summary: The New York City Department of Correction is seeking another extension on its telecommunications contract with Securus. Critics have said the company's technology violates the privacy not only of inmates, but their friends and families.

title: Texas efficiency office launches AI chatbot to help public navigate regulations, licensing
summary: Texas' State Administration Manager, or SAM, only pulls "from fact," said Jerome Greener, director of the Texas Regulatory Efficiency Office.

title: Limiting construction noise, detecting potholes priorities for rising NYC transit tech startups
summary: The latest cohort of companies to receive support from the Transit Tech Lab are targeting common issues surrounding transit, including how loud it can be to build its infrastructure.

title: States move to formalize AI governance as adoption expands, report finds
summary: Creating governance councils and setting clear usage guidelines are AI best practices (used by many states, though not all) recommended by a report from the UC Berkeley School of Information.

title: New Jersey announces new transit app, other tech upgrades as part of governor’s ‘Rapid Action Plan’
summary: NJ Transit's new app is part of Gov. Mikie Sherrill's broader plan to improve the state's public transportation system.

title: AI guardrails should be dynamic, evolving, says Alabama’s AI chief
summary: Aaron Wright, Alabama's new chief AI officer, said he wants the state's AI guardrails to become a continuously evolving framework.
